summary: Independently re-review the fixed Hermes route bridge
requiredTools: warm pnpm content-addressed store for the frozen lockfile
objective: Using a different reviewer profile from the blocked REV-001 attempt, independently attack immutable CR12B-IDEA-110B implementation commit 0a736ad16e1ea7ffef37e434eba5bd46f483f95d. Determine whether the fixed Hermes bridge safely reuses connector-owned local or SSH routing without exposing locators or native identities, widening the signed permit, repeating a provider call, accepting replay or gateway-epoch drift, or converting uncertainty into success. Produce one source-linked report plus the required isolated V2 result manifest. Do not repair code, change architecture, contact Hermes, approve the block, or merge anything. This is the replacement for the preparation-blocked REV-001 review, not a retry of any native or provider effect.
semanticAcceptance: The report names exact implementation commit 0a736ad16e1ea7ffef37e434eba5bd46f483f95d, names a reviewer profile different from REV-001, and declares that the reviewer profile authored, repaired, and advised none of its product changes; any overlap produces blocked_incomplete_review.

The first command is the only setup authority: it may create checkout-local node_modules and read the existing pnpm store, but it must remain offline, frozen-lockfile, lifecycle-script-policy bound, and stop on any cache miss without network fallback.

Before drawing a disposition, the reviewer executes every route-custody, fixed-turn, replay, authority, durable-spend, cleanup, sanitation, and upgrade-boundary attack required by docs/reviews/CR12B_IDEA_110B_INDEPENDENT_REVIEW_PACKET.md.

Every finding has a stable ID, severity, exact source line, reproducible attack, observed result, violated invariant, affected boundary, missing regression, and smallest safe remediation; passing producer tests alone are never a finding disposition.

The report separates independently observed source and test facts from documented, inferred, blocked, and unsupported claims and retains every real enrollment, owner qualification, receipt review, architect acceptance, live-panel, production database, hosting, and deployment blocker.
The only final disposition is accepted_provider_disabled_snapshot, remediation_required, or blocked_incomplete_review; it does not approve, merge, enroll, qualify, or contact Hermes.

The report contains no secret, raw host identity, machine locator, key material or path, gateway value, protected value, profile path, native session identifier, raw provider content, private infrastructure detail, personal path, production artifact, invented observation, source repair, architecture decision, or native/live effect claim.

The worker commits only the report as the implementation commit, then commits coordination/agent-build/results/CR12B-IDEA-110B-REV-002.json alone as the required metadata commit exactly as skills/agent-build-worker/SKILL.md specifies.
stopConditions: Stop and leave the jobber unclaimed if Git, Node.js, pnpm 11.19.0, authenticated GitHub CLI, or the warm pnpm store prerequisite is unavailable.

After CLAIM ACCEPTED, the only dependency preparation authority is CI=true pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --offline in the isolated checkout. It may write checkout-local node_modules and read the pnpm store; stop on a cache miss, package-policy error, prompt, or any request for network access. Do not retry, link another checkout, approve builds, alter package policy, or use the online fallback.
Stop and submit a blocked report if the reviewer profile produced REV-001, authored, repaired, or advised the immutable implementation, or cannot establish independence.

Stop if implementation commit 0a736ad16e1ea7ffef37e434eba5bd46f483f95d is unavailable, differs from the capsule, or the review would require changing any product path or any path other than the report plus the separately required result manifest metadata commit.
Stop before repairing source, tests, contracts, migrations, workflow files, dependencies, acceptance criteria, or prior evidence; report findings for Codex disposition.

Stop before any Hermes or native process, SSH connection, provider call, credential or protected-value access, Keychain or vault action, service, listener, database outside disposable tests, external integration, deployment, DNS, hosting, destructive cleanup, or consequential effect.
